note: Real 400 rejections of a forced tool_choice (2026-10-02). anthropic_api.body is the Messages API response body as captured (request_id dropped), identical for a forced `any` on claude-opus-5-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5. The bedrock messages are verbatim from bedrock-runtime on us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5: Converse with toolChoice any wraps the message in the model-errors prefix, InvokeModel with a named tool (and with `any`) returns it bare. Both carry the ValidationException discriminator, lifted onto Error::Upstream.upstream_type as the bare name; the bodies are the flat {"message":...} shape bedrock-runtime returns. Kept as a data file, never inline .rs literals.
